post.description: The route through the waypoints that keeps time on main roads down: each minute on a road type its road_rules avoid counts penalty times over (or the type's own strength in road_factors). Times include turns, traffic signals and stop signs (delay_seconds). sources picks who plans: our own router (ours) and/or other engines (see GET /api/routing/status), each asked for its backroads route and alternatives (our own router plans its own alternatives on different roads). Every route is measured on our map and scored the same way, and the best alternatives routes come back, best first. Plans are cached for 15 minutes. A source that fails is listed in problems and the rest still answer. With compare_fastest, the plain fastest route on our map comes last (compare=true). A waypoint with no road within routing.max_snap_m is refused with its index.

post.description: Set who may view one of your routes: people by name (they open it with its link, /r/<token>, or from Shared with me), and/or anyone at all, no sign-in, with its public link (send the route as planned in trip). Send no users and public false to make it private again.

parameters.description: The saved route's id, from GET /api/saved-routes.
parameters.name: route_id

public.description: Let anyone at all view it, with no sign-in, at /v/<public_token>: the map and navigation only. Needs trip when it is turned on. Left out: unchanged. Turning it off and on again makes a new link.

trip.description: The route as planned now, for the public link to show. Sent while public is on, it replaces the snapshot and keeps the link.

users.description: User ids to share it with by name (GET /api/team). Replaces the list; ids of people who cannot sign in, and your own, are left out.

get.description: Other people's routes they shared with you by name, most recently changed first, a page at a time. Routes shared only by link are not listed; open their link.

parameters.description: Rows to return. Default 200.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Rows to skip: the next value of the previous page.
parameters.name: offset

next.description: Offset of the next page, or null on the last one.

get.description: The route behind a link, if it is yours or shared with you by name, to plan it again. A route not shared with you answers 404, the same as no route.

parameters.description: The token from the route's link, /r/<token>.
parameters.name: token

get.description: People with an active account (not service accounts), a page at a time: id and display name.

parameters.description: Rows to return. Default 200.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Rows to skip: the next value of the previous page.
parameters.name: offset

next.description: Offset of the next page, or null on the last one.
